sequential_dependency.intermediate: The blocking rectangle together with its uniquely farther protruding side; in this selected case the color-9 route yields bounce directions up, left, then down and the color-4 route yields down.
sequential_dependency.step_a: For each turned run, detect the first original blocking rectangle and compare how far it protrudes on the two sides perpendicular to the incoming motion.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Redirect the whole color-8 brush along that selected side, continue until the next edge or blocker, and repeat the same selection when another blocker is met.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The continuation direction after contact is not fixed by the header turn: it depends on the encountered rectangle bounding box and the brush position, so omitting that input-dependent side selection stops the route early and changes the final painted union.

parametric_work.summary: Matched-input header/opposite adapter with two-demo finite-rival identification, four distinct queries, real Racket/Python parity, sequential public views, and executable blocker-side causal replay.

target.summary: Authored and self-reviewed a complete thick-cursor public family with canonical header-relative turns, obstacle-side bounces, and an opposite-turn branch.
